remarks: Welcome to 2420 23rd St, a 4,858 sq ft newly constructed wellness retreat on a sprawling 29,550 sq ft lot with private lake access in Newport Beach, CA. This luxury home combines comfort and well-being, featuring five spacious bedrooms, six bathrooms, and a master retreat with high ceilings and elegant finishes. Designed for relaxation and entertaining, the home includes a movie room, a flex space with a bar, and a vanishing-edge pool with a cascading waterfall, all set among lush landscaping and mature trees.
